_readme: Client testimonials. While placeholder:true, the displayed card shows a small badge and the Review schema JSON-LD is suppressed. When real testimonials with written permission arrive, flip placeholder:false and the badge / honest disclosure disappears.

items.quote: Their team is exactly what they promise — disciplined, on time, and the supervisor actually picks up the phone. Compliance paperwork has been flawless across our last three audits.

items.quote: We switched from two separate agencies to SSS for integrated security and housekeeping. The single-supervisor model saved us roughly 10% on costs and the escalation process is finally straightforward.
items.name: Priya Menon

items.quote: Hospital security requires a different temperament — patient families are stressed, OPD queues are long. SSS trained their team specifically for healthcare settings. We have had zero incidents in two years.
